content: संस्थापनम् .²1 Placing or keeping together, collecting. .²2 Fixing, determining, regulating; कुर्वीत चैषां प्रत्यक्षमर्घसंस्थापनं नृपः <ls>Ms. 8. 402</ls>. .²3 Establishment, confirmation; धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे <ls>Bg. 4. 8</ls>. .²5 Restraining, curbing. .²6 A statute, regulation. .{@-ना@} .²1 Restraining, curbing. .²2 A means of calming or composing; संस्थापना प्रियतरा विरहातुराणाम् <ls>Mk. 3. 3</ls>.
